slide_title: Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance

layout.arrangement: White slide enclosed in a thin maroon rectangular frame. Bold maroon title centered across the top, with a yellow circular slide-number badge (25) at the top-right corner. Upper-left quadrant holds a small generic confusion matrix (TP/FN/FP/TN) with a red-bordered 'Threshold=0.6' label to its right and a larger numeric confusion matrix (3,2 / 1,5) below it. Upper-center/right holds a cream rounded-rectangle flowchart: Test Sample → Model → (0 --- 1) → Threshold → Class I / Class II. The entire bottom half is a number-line scatter: a horizontal 0.0–1.0 axis with tick marks and red labels, a dashed purple vertical line at ≈0.6, and nine hand-drawn airplane sketches scattered above the axis (five red-dotted planes left of the line, four blue-dotted skull-marked planes right of it).

regions.name: title bar
regions.content: Maroon bold title centered; yellow circle badge with '25' at top-right (~89-93% x, 9-15% y)

regions.name: confusion matrices + threshold label
regions.content: Small 3x3 TP/FN/FP/TN matrix (~8-17% x, 17-26% y); red-bordered 'Threshold=0.6' box to its right (~19-32% x, 20-26% y); larger numeric matrix with cells 3,2 / 1,5 below (~10-24% x, 28-42% y)

regions.name: pipeline flowchart
regions.content: Cream rounded rectangle containing: 'Test Sample' label + small gray plane sketch → red arrow → maroon 'Model' box with yellow '[Any value] → (0, +1)' and purple sigmoid circle → red arrow → blue-bordered '(0 --- 1)' box under 'Predicted Value' label → red arrow → tall red-bordered vertical 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' box → two branching red arrows → green 'Class I' box and pink 'Class II' box

regions.name: number-line scatter area
regions.content: Horizontal dark-red axis at ~79% height from ~9% to ~93% width with ticks every 0.1 and red labels 0.0 / 0.5 / 1.0; dashed purple vertical line at ~58% x (≈0.6) running from below the flowchart down to the axis; nine airplane sketches above the axis; small black cursor arrow near the line's base

layout.hierarchy: The maroon bold title is the largest text and dominates the top. The cream flowchart is the largest single graphic (top-right). The two confusion matrices are small supporting elements at top-left. By area, the airplane scatter plus the 0–1 axis dominate the bottom half. Red/maroon accents (title, frame, threshold box, matrix numbers, flow arrows, axis, red dots) visually unify the slide; purple marks the sigmoid and the threshold line; green/pink mark the two output classes.

visual_elements.description: Small generic confusion matrix, 3x3 grid with black thin borders. Top label 'Predicted as' above the two column headers; column headers 'P' and 'N'; rotated 'Actual' label on the left spanning both rows; row headers 'P' and 'N'. Cells: row P = TP (green fill), FN; row N = FP, TN (green fill). Corner cell empty.
colors: #92D050 green fill on TP and TN

visual_elements.description: White rectangle with red border containing red bold text 'Threshold=0.6'.
visual_elements.position: top-left area, ~19-32% x, ~20-26% y, right of the small matrix

visual_elements.description: Larger numeric confusion matrix, 3x3 grid with red borders on all cells. 'Predicted as' label above columns; column headers 'P', 'N'; rotated 'Actual' label at left; row headers 'P', 'N'. Cell values: row P = 3, 2; row N = 1, 5. All numbers red.
visual_elements.position: top-left, ~10-24% x, ~28-42% y, below the small matrix

visual_elements.description: Cream rounded-rectangle container holding a left-to-right pipeline. Node 1: bold black label 'Test Sample' above a small gray-outline airplane sketch. Red arrow → Node 2: maroon filled rectangle with white bold 'Model' and yellow small text '[Any value] → (0, +1)' beneath; a purple-outlined circle with light-purple fill containing a purple sigmoid (S) curve overlaps the right side of the Model box. Red arrow → Node 3: white box with blue border and blue text '(0 --- 1)', with bold black label 'Predicted Value' above it. Red arrow → Node 4: tall narrow white box with red border containing vertically rotated red text 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)'. Two red arrows branch from its right side: upper arrow → green rounded rectangle 'Class I'; lower arrow → pink rounded rectangle 'Class II'.
colors: #F8BBD0 Class II fill with red/pink border

visual_elements.description: Horizontal number line (scatter of categorical markers). Dark-red horizontal axis from 0.0 to 1.0 with tick marks at every 0.1; red labels '0.0' (left end), '0.5' (middle), '1.0' (right end) below the axis. A dashed purple vertical line at ≈0.6 extends from just below the flowchart down to the axis. Nine hand-drawn airplane outline markers sit above the axis at varied heights: five planes with a red dot at the tail located left of the dashed line (approx. x 16-41%), four planes with a blue dot and a small skull-and-crossbones on the fuselage located right of the line (approx. x 58-86%, one at bottom-center essentially at the line).
colors: #FF0000 axis labels and red plane dots
visual_elements.position: bottom half, axis at ~79% height spanning ~9-93% width; planes between ~43-72% height

visual_elements.description: Dashed purple vertical threshold line at x ≈ 58% (value ≈ 0.6) from ~40% height down to the axis; a small black mouse-cursor arrow points at the line just above the axis (~62% x, ~79% y) — screenshot artifact.
Yellow circle badge in the top-right corner containing the dark slide number '25'.
Thin maroon rectangular frame inset ~2% from all slide edges, enclosing the entire content area.

imagery: Nine hand-drawn airplane sketches (gray outline, propeller-plane doodle style) scattered above the number line: five on the left of the dashed line each with a small red dot at the tail; four on the right each with a small blue dot at the tail and a tiny skull-and-crossbones drawn on the fuselage (pirate planes). One blue-dot plane sits at bottom-center essentially where the dashed line meets the axis.
One small gray-outline airplane sketch inside the flowchart container, representing the 'Test Sample' input (~40 px wide).
Purple sigmoid (S-shaped) curve drawn inside a light-purple circle, attached to the right side of the maroon 'Model' box.
Small black mouse-cursor arrow near the base of the dashed purple line (screenshot artifact).

accents: #FF0000 (red: Threshold=0.6 box, matrix numbers/borders, flow arrows, axis labels, red plane dots, Threshold box)

typography_notes: All text is sans-serif (Calibri/Arial-like). Title is bold, ~30 pt, maroon, horizontally centered near the top. Flowchart labels 'Test Sample', 'Predicted Value', 'Model' are bold ~13-14 pt (black, except white 'Model'). Matrix text ~11 pt black; matrix numbers red ~12 pt. 'Actual' labels in both matrices and the 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' text are rotated 90° (vertical, reading bottom-to-top). Axis labels red ~12 pt. No italics, no bullet lists, no all-caps except matrix abbreviations (TP/FN/FP/TN, P/N).
animation_state: Fully revealed; no partial build or hidden elements. A small black mouse-cursor arrow is visible just right of the dashed threshold line near the axis (screenshot artifact, not slide content).
recreation_brief: 1. Start with a blank white 16:9 slide; draw a thin maroon (#9E1B32) rectangle border inset ~2% around the whole slide. 2. Add the centered title at top: 'Effect of Selecting Threshold Value on Model Performance' — bold, ~30 pt, sans-serif, color #9E1B32. 3. Top-right: yellow (#FFD966) circle with dark text '25'. 4. Top-left: build a 3x3 table with black borders — label 'Predicted as' above columns, headers P/N, rotated 'Actual' label at left, rows P/N; fill TP and TN cells green (#92D050); cells read TP, FN / FP, TN. 5. To its right: white box with red (#FF0000) border and red bold text 'Threshold=0.6'. 6. Below: second 3x3 table, same structure, all cells red-bordered with red numbers: row P = 3, 2; row N = 1, 5; 'Predicted as' above, rotated 'Actual' at left. 7. Top-center/right: draw a cream (#FFF2CC) rounded rectangle with gold (#BF9000) border. Inside, left to right: bold 'Test Sample' label above a small gray airplane sketch; red arrow; maroon (#9E1B32) rectangle with white bold 'Model' and yellow (#FFD966) small text '[Any value] → (0, +1)'; purple (#7030A0) circle with light-purple fill and a purple sigmoid curve overlapping the Model box's right edge; red arrow; white box with blue (#4472C4) border and blue text '(0 --- 1)' with bold 'Predicted Value' label above; red arrow; tall narrow white box with red border containing vertical (rotated 90°) red text 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)'; two red arrows branching right to a green (#C6E0B4, #70AD47 border) rounded box 'Class I' and a pink (#F8BBD0, red border) rounded box 'Class II'. 8. Bottom: draw a dark-red (#C00000) horizontal axis line with tick marks every 0.1; add red labels '0.0', '0.5', '1.0' beneath left end, middle, right end. 9. Draw a dashed purple (#7030A0) vertical line at the 0.6 position from below the flowchart down to the axis; optionally add a small black arrow pointing at it. 10. Scatter nine airplane doodle sketches (gray outlines) above the axis: five with a red dot at the tail placed left of the dashed line at varied heights/sizes, four with a blue dot and small skull-and-crossbones placed right of the line (one at bottom-center at the line). 11. Use Calibri/Arial throughout; bold for title and flowchart labels; rotate 'Actual' and 'Threshold (e.g. 0.5)' text 90°.
